scope.catalog_scope: Concierge fashion inventory: apparel, footwear and fashion accessories. Beauty, home and other non-fashion merchandise are outside this clothing-focused audit except where an item is wearable fashion.

source_access.base44_result: Both The Concierge and Concierge Pro environments returned HTTP 200 for robots.txt, the official sitemap index, fashion section sitemaps, category pages and sampled public product pages.
source_access.crawl_controls: Only ordinary public pages and the published sitemap were used. Disallowed servlet/search/facet paths from robots.txt were not used.

controlled_validation.data_quality_rule: Visible size/color lists are source evidence only. No active ProductVariant is retained unless a sellable size/color/width combination is explicitly confirmed. Dillard's prices remain style-level RetailerOffers.

completion_status.exact_gap: The official sitemap provides exhaustive fashion PDP URL discovery but not complete product metadata, size-color combinations, live price or availability. Completing 71,678 unique PDPs from public HTML would require tens of thousands of individual product-page requests. No permitted official bulk Dillard's product metadata feed or API was identified during this audit, and a high-volume crawl was not used as a substitute.
completion_status.required_for_full_completion: A permitted Dillard's bulk product/merchant/affiliate feed or official API/export carrying product identity, variants, live price and availability; alternatively, a deliberately rate-limited incremental PDP ingestion program can work through the 71,678 discovered URLs over time without bypassing published controls.

image_policy: Dillard-hosted image URLs were not promoted into public ProductMaster image fields. Attribution or a copyright disclaimer alone is not treated as permission to display retailer/brand imagery.

integrity_correction.root_cause: The manual pilot path incorrectly used Dillard's retailer product IDs in ProductMaster canonical identity and promoted default-color observations into active ProductVariant rows.
repaired_state: Three ProductMaster canonical keys now use brand + normalized product name as review candidates because no manufacturer style/MPN/GTIN was verified.
Dillard's product IDs remain only as retailer/source identifiers.
Three color-only ProductVariant rows were invalidated and retained only for audit history.
Three Dillard's offers were detached from those variants and converted to style scope.
A correction CatalogIngestionRun was recorded in both apps.
